notes.title: You could help bring Playne to Mobile (iOS/Android)
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

Over the years, many of you have asked me for a mobile version of Playne, and I'm totally on board! but the challenges of developing a mobile version are very real. 1) funding its development, and 2) navigating the crowded mobile market, which as a solo developer, is very intimidating.

But it might be possible to create Playne for Mobile with your help.

[b]Would you back a crowdfunding campaign for Playne Mobile?[/b] With a Kickstarter campaign, by pre-purchasing Playne for Mobile, you could help fund the project and make Playne for Mobile a reality!

[h3]Playne for Mobile Features[/h3]
More people built a 30-day habit of meditation sitting in front of their computer playing Playne than some of the most popular meditation and mindfulness apps on mobile. Playne for mobile will build on this success and continue to make it easier for you to build a consistent daily habit of meditation using the power of video games :)

How is the mobile version different from Playne? For starters, it'll have all the improvements from the lessons I've learned developing Playne, and Inward.

[list]
[*] You can take it (almost) anywhere. 
[*] Grow your island, and make it into a beautiful sanctuary.
[*] Craft soundscapes with more views, more weather types, and objects that add to the ambiance.
[*] Bigger collection of meditations.
[*] oh and Fox will be back!

[h2]Wishlist is Live![/h2]
You can wishlist Playne for mobile to get notified when the campaign launches. Your wishlist helps to understand the appetite for this campaign, and it'll help the project with visibility on Kickstarter, which would be huge!

notes.title: Biomes + VR Update Released
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

I'm really excited to release one of the most significant updates for Playne so far that brings biomes and many improvements for VR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32875930/f906ea55f3333f88a7a1048b80327525a9d480e5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Biomes😄 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Grow new species of trees for Story, Sandbox and Evolve modes
[*] Three new species of trees: Aspen, Beech and Lombardy Poplar
[*] Completed Playne? Create multiple instances and start the journey again
[*] Choose trees that grow at different rates
[/list]

[h1]Improvements & Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Torch that illuminate the ground to help you plant seeds at night in Sandbox mode.
[*] Many typos have been fixed. 👊 Huge thanks to those of you that sent me details of typos in the game. 
[*] Birds now tweet again during the day 🤷🏽‍♂️ 
[*] Better, more realistic water
[*] Steam Cloud save load quota increased to accommodate bigger saves
[*] Various other minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h1] VR Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Full graphics overhaul and engine tweaks. Game should be crisper, performance should be better.
[*] New tutorial system gives you better onboarding onto Playne VR
[*] New dialogue interaction system for Fox. You will no longer need to walk around the fox to get the best angle so you can read the dialogue window (🤦🏽‍♂️ what was I thinking? part I)
[*] Game controls rethink and redesign. Gone are the complicated grip system for the weather and time power (🤦🏽‍♂️what was I thinking? part II)
[*] Planting controls rethink and redesign. You no longer need to actually touch the ground to plant the seeds (🤦🏽‍♂️what was I thinking? part III)
[*] Sandbox seed view needs less hand turn 
[*] New weather and time UI
[*] Cosmos and G2 controller added, although still not officially supported until a few of you can confirm that they work 🤷🏽‍♂️
[*] New, dare I say more beautiful, main menu
[*[ Better, clearer settings ui
[*] Better laser that doesn't shoot beyond the menu + full laser pointer system
[*] Grip should no longer interfere with interactions on Index
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sandbox and Story mode will no longer grow together. You now need to choose which biome/game mode you want to grow by meditating there. However you will still earn seeds for sandbox mode when you meditate in story mode.
[*] The original tree in Playne now grows in 60 days, about twice as fast as before. I've reduced this since you can now grow multiple biomes.
[/list] 

[h3]New Bug Tracking and Feature Request System[/h3]
You can add, comment and vote on bug reports and feature requests. 👍 ??
Playne: https://vismaya.upvoty.com/b/playne/
Playne VR: https://vismaya.upvoty.com/b/playne-vr/

💖 G'ma, 💖 AcidOxidant, 💖 Barbara Weitbrecht, 💖 Erzhena Soktoeva, 💖 Holger, 💖 Jesse Hutchison, 💖 John Hounihan, 💖 Juan Fassone, 💖 Karl, 💖 Matt Gray, 💖 Maxime Attimont, 💖 Meditation Mind, 💖 Michelle Roberts, 💖 pitgamer, 💖 za7ch, 💖 Agelorus, 💖 Elizabeth Parks, 💖 Rodney Armand, 💖 Christian BÃ¶ning, 💖 Jesus Redondo, 💖 jussi, 💖 Kidjchai Yingsery, 💖 Konohura, 💖 Margaret Howe, 💖 Michiel Krol, 💖 Oliver Waegner,💖 Sasha Hernandez, 💖 VagrantFox.

[h3]Special Thanks[/h3]
Special thanks to G'ma for being one of the first to plant over 1,000 trees in Playne and supporting me for such a long time on Patreon. Also, big thanks to KalisChilde and the other mods for looking over the Discord. Thanks also to all you folks who helped me with testing this update.

[h3]Translations[/h3]
Translations are a bit sketchy at the moment on Playne, and this is my fault since I've had to either redraft or redo some of the text on each patch. I'm doing localisation with our translators next so hopefully we can get some of this cleaned up. Until this happens, I'm removing the official 'interface localised' classification on Steam.

[h3]Partners[/h3]
Lastly, make sure you check out the [url=https://discord.gg/UQUDwzMuPt]partners channel on Payne's discord[/url]. There are some wonderful communities that we are partnered with, including [url=https://discord.gg/KxzMX7t] Meditation Mind[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/safertogether]Safe in Our World[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/HWx56BVAEC]Guardians Mental Health[/url].

notes.title: Playne VR is here!
notes.content:
Friends,

I'm so excited to announce that after a year of work, Playne VR is finally here!

[h2]How much is the VR Version and how do I get it?[/h2]

[b]Playne VR is a free DLC update to Playne.[/b] If you own Playne, you get the VR functionality for free.

You can download the DLC here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1525880/Playne_VR/

[h2]Supported VR Headsets[/h2]

Valve Index, HTC Vive and Oculus Rift is initially supported. I am planning on adding HP Reverb G2 compatibility once I iron out this beta build. 

[h2]Thank you Closed Beta Testers![/h2]

Thank you all that took part in the closed Beta program. All of you have helped me develop a less broken game, and for that I'm grateful. Some of you even took the time to send me super detailed bug reports and emails which I really do appreciate. Playne VR is so much better thanks to all you! 

[h2]VR is in Early Access (Beta)[/h2]

This is still a BETA build so some things might still be broken. If you find something that doesn't work or If you think of something I could improvement, then do let me know! Although I might not be able to implement everything (solo dev here :-) I do read every single input from you guys.

You can submit an issue via the link below or email an issue directly to support (at) playne.co:
https://github.com/krishkrush/PlayneVR/issues/new/choose

If you can't be bothered with that, then just drop a message on our discord channel.

[h2]Lastly, Thank you to all my Patreons[/h2]

Thanks also to each and every one of my [url=patreon.com/krishs]Patreon[/url] supporters below for their continued support.  As a solo dev making super niche games, your support is incredibly meaningful to me.

Initially I was thinking of releasing the VR port as a separate version, but after giving it a lot of thought  [b]I’ve decided to release the VR port of Playne as a free update to Playne. [/b]

This means that once this update is released (Jan 2021) Playne will officially support VR, without needing to purchase a separate version. Here is a wee preview of the VR build:

I’m not big on awards, but the visibility Payne could get with a mention here would be game changing (ooo pun :)

[b]Monday group meditations like these are a great way to start the week. [/b]

[h2]Lastly[/h2]

“I began to understand that suffering and disappointments and melancholy are there not to vex us or cheapen us or deprive us of our dignity but to mature and transfigure us.”
― Hermann Hesse,

It’s human to suffer, it’s human to want to overcome suffering, it's human to want to help those who suffer. [i]You are not alone in suffering[/i]

Mental Health Resources: https://safeinourworld.org/

notes.title: Update Released : A Better Fox
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Thanks to everyone who’s supported Playne since its full release earlier this year. I’m so happy to see so many active daily players, exploring meditation with Playne.

I’d like to announce a brand new update, which  brings some significant upgrades to your guide, your mentor, your friend, the fox. As well as a number of other improvements. 

[h2]🦊Fox Upgrade: Improved Dialogue[/h2]
[list][*][i][b]Fully Enhanced Fox Script:[/b][/i] Most of the dialogue of your fox guide has been augmented, redrafted and improved. A lot of effort has gone into making the instructions for meditation even clearer and easier to understand.
[*][i][b]Better dialogue interface:[/b][/i][i] [/i]Less cluttered dialogue window and more natural dialogue flow and connections.[/list]
[h2]🦊Fox Upgrade: Other Improvements[/h2]
[list][*][i][b]Fox encourages you: [/b][/i]New event-driven dialogue system with over 20 new dialogue strands. What does this mean? Well, Fox will now nudge you with encouragement and enlighten/annoy you with its wisdom (you choose which!) 
[*][i][b]Improved movement: [/b][/i]Fox will now walk, trot and run to you! Animation glitches have also been removed, and transitions have been improved as well. 
[*][i][b]Better dialogue screen: [/b][/i]In Sandbox/Evolve Mode, the dialogue view has been improved. I can’t find another way to say it, apart from that it looks prettier.[/list]
[h2]🌳Sandbox improvements[/h2]
[list][*][b][i]Planting distance indicator: [/i][/b]The crosshair on the HUD will now tell you when you are far enough away from a tree to plant a new seed. Frantically spamming the plant key is no longer needed :) 
[*][b][i]Improved notifications:[/i][/b][b] [/b]Better instructions to help you understand and get feedback on the planting system. Game instructions have also been added to the Pause menu for new players.[/list]
[h2]🛠️Other Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]Grammar / Spelilng fixes. :- |
[*]Escape menu no longer intrudes on the achievements window.
[*]Better achievements UI .
[*]Better lantern (the polygon-y look wasn’t great, was it?).
[*]'Remove guide text' option now actually removes guide text in meditation.
[*]Crosshair dot is bigger! Why did I think a pixel wide crosshair was a good idea?
[*]More prominent quest guide text.
[*]Reaching level cap is now indicated in progress menu.
[*]The volume of the fire can now be adjusted.
[*]Quotes no longer disappear in your second session.
[*]Fox no longer get warped around objects.
[*]Outline of interactable objects in Story Mode has been improved.
[*]Notifications no longer disappear in Sandbox / Evolve Mode.
[*]+Other minor fixes and improvements.[/list]
[h2]🌍Localisation Issues?[/h2]
[b]Due to the range of changes to the dialogue text, some existing  localisations might appear incomplete or broken. Our community translators are working on adding these localisation  (thank you!).  lI’ll release this as a patch as soon as it’s completed. [/b]

[b]Although Playne doesn’t officially support localization of game text, it's nice to have the translators who make the effort to bring Playne to countries that otherwise might not be able to experience it. [/b]

[b]If any of you would like to join our community translators and help me update the missing localisations,  then drop me an email at krish (at) playne.co. If you have already contacted me (and I haven’t been back in touch) don’t worry, I will reach out to you soon.[/b]

[h2]🌱Planting Trees[/h2]
Well done to all of you who have unlocked Evolve Mode over the last few months, allowing us to plant one tree in real life for every player who did so. I’ll soon be announcing the details of trees planted as part of this!

[h2]💬Experiencing issues with this update?[/h2]
I’ve had a group of volunteers who took the time to test this update (thank you!) But as a solo dev,  I don’t have a lot of different dev environments that I can test Playne on.

If you experience any issues or bugs, then let me know by posting on the discussion forum here on Steam.  You can also easily revert back to the previous version [i](Right click Playne on your Steam Library > Properties > BETAS and select branch [/i][u][b][i]LastRelease[/i][/b][/u][i])[/i]

[h2]🙏Thank you![/h2]
Thanks to everyone who made the effort to let me know how I can improve Playne, as well as suggestions for improvement.

Special thanks to my Patreons for continuing to support me in making games like  Playne 🙏:

We’ve got a range of updates for you including some big changes to the levelling system.

[h1][b]Fully Revamped Progress System[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Day Based Levelling System: Each day you spend meditating will now progress you through the game. [/*]

[h1] [b]Dynamic Tree Growth[/b] [/h1]
The tree growth stages are now fully dynamic. 

Before we had a handful of separate growth stages as defined by your player level, but now you have a fully dynamic growth system. This means that your trees will grow on every single day of meditation.

[h1][b] Visual upgrade[/b] [/h1]
